name: Swiss Cheese Plant (Monstera)
description: Iconic indoor specimen famous for its dramatic fenestrated foliage. A quintessential centerpiece for biophilic interior spaces.

images.alt: Monstera deliciosa leaf close-up in biophilic living room
Fenestrated split-leaf Monstera flourishing in soft ambient morning light

guide.growthHabit: Climbing vine with deeply perforated leaves at maturity; benefits from a moss pole.
guide.soil: Rich, well-draining potting medium blended with peat moss, perlite, and orchid bark.
guide.container: Terracotta or ceramic pot with drainage holes, minimum 25cm diameter.
guide.watering: Water once every 7-10 days. Allow top 3-5cm of soil to dry before watering thoroughly.
guide.routineCare: Apply balanced liquid fertilizer monthly in spring/summer. Wipe leaves regularly with a damp cloth.

toxicityCaution.note: Contains insoluble calcium oxalate crystals which can cause oral swelling and nausea in dogs and cats.

name: Snake Plant
description: Remarkably resilient architectural succulent featuring upright sword-like leaves with vivid yellow-green margins. Renowned for nocturnal air purification.

images.alt: Golden Snake Plant upright sword-shaped leaves
Architectural upright blades of Sansevieria

guide.growthHabit: Upright, rosette clustering of rigid sword-shaped architectural leaves.
guide.soil: Fast-draining cactus and succulent mix with pumice or perlite.
guide.container: Heavy ceramic or terracotta container with reliable drainage.
guide.watering: Water sparingly every 2-3 weeks; allow soil to dry completely between waterings.
guide.routineCare: Minimal feeding needed; once in spring. Wipe foliage occasionally to remove dust.

toxicityCaution.note: Contains saponins that cause nausea or gastrointestinal discomfort in pets if ingested.

name: Fiddle-Leaf Fig
description: Magnificent statement indoor tree featuring large, glossy violin-shaped foliage with pronounced sculptural veining.

images.alt: Mature Fiddle Leaf Fig tree in interior setting
Grand violin-shaped foliage of Ficus lyrata

guide.growthHabit: Upright tree habit with substantial architectural leaves on a woody trunk.
guide.soil: Rich, well-aerated potting mix with compost and orchid bark.
guide.container: Substantial planter with drainage; avoid frequent repotting.
guide.watering: Water when top 5cm is dry, roughly every 7-10 days. Avoid waterlogging roots.
guide.routineCare: Requires consistent bright indirect light; rotate weekly for symmetrical growth.

toxicityCaution.note: Milky sap contains ficin and furocoumarins that can irritate skin and mouth.

name: Calathea Orbifolia
description: Exquisite prayer plant showcasing large, rounded foliage marked with delicate metallic silver and emerald brushstrokes.

images.alt: Calathea orbifolia wide round leaves with silver stripes
Hypnotic silver brushstrokes on broad round prayer plant foliage

guide.growthHabit: Clumping herbaceous perennial with diurnal nyctinastic leaf movement.
guide.soil: Moisture-retentive, loose substrate with peat moss and perlite.
guide.container: Wide shallow pot with multiple bottom drainage holes.
guide.watering: Keep substrate evenly moist using filtered or rainwater. Water every 5-7 days.
guide.routineCare: Thrives in high humidity (60%+). Shield strictly from harsh direct sun rays.

toxicityCaution.note: Non-toxic and completely pet-safe for cats and dogs.

name: English Lavender
description: Aromatic perennial shrub with silver-green foliage and calming fragrant purple flower spikes, thriving in airy sunny environments.

images.alt: Fragrant purple English Lavender flowers in bloom

guide.growthHabit: Bushy compact subshrub with fragrant blooms.
guide.soil: Gritty, lean, well-draining alkaline soil mix.
guide.container: Unglazed terracotta pot with ample aeration holes.
guide.watering: Water deeply when soil is completely dry. Avoid waterlogging roots.
guide.routineCare: Prune lightly after blooming to maintain compact bushy form. Full sun essential.

toxicityCaution.note: Contains linalool which can cause mild upset in pets if ingested in quantity.

name: Golden Pothos
description: Versatile and forgiving trailing vine adorned with heart-shaped leaves variegated in golden-yellow and emerald green.

images.alt: Golden Pothos trailing heart-shaped foliage
Marbled ivory and jade trailing foliage

guide.growthHabit: Cascading or climbing vine with aerial rootlets.
guide.soil: Standard all-purpose potting soil with perlite.
guide.container: Hanging basket or pot with trellis/pole support.
guide.watering: Allow top half of soil to dry before watering, typically every 7 days.
guide.routineCare: Trim leggy stems to encourage bushier growth. Highly adaptable to low light.

toxicityCaution.note: Insoluble oxalates cause oral irritation in pets if chewed.

name: ZZ Plant
description: Extremely durable low-light champion with feather-like stems and glossy, waxy deep green leaflets rising from underground rhizomes.

images.alt: Glossy green ZZ Plant stems in minimalist neutral interior
Resilient Zamioculcas zamiifolia foliage

guide.growthHabit: Upright arching stems emerging from thick tuberous rhizomes.
guide.soil: Well-draining, porous potting medium with coarse sand.
guide.container: Sturdy planter with good drainage.
guide.watering: Water thoroughly every 2-3 weeks; highly tolerant of neglect and drought.
guide.routineCare: Wipe glossy leaves periodically. Can thrive under fluorescent office lighting.

toxicityCaution.note: Mildly toxic due to calcium oxalate crystals.

name: Peace Lily
description: Graceful shade-loving plant with lustrous dark green foliage and long-lasting pristine white flower spathes. Natural air purifier.

images.alt: Peace Lily white spathe flowering amidst deep dark green leaves

guide.growthHabit: Clump-forming evergreen perennial producing erect flower stalks.
guide.soil: Peat-based potting soil rich in organic matter.
guide.container: Moisture-retentive ceramic container with drainage.
guide.watering: Water when topsoil feels barely dry; plant visibly droops when thirsty.
guide.routineCare: Keep in moderate indirect light; mist leaves to sustain ambient humidity.

toxicityCaution.note: Calcium oxalate crystals cause irritation if chewed by pets.

name: Spider Plant
description: Classic and prolific indoor plant with arching ribbon-like variegated leaves and miniature plantlets cascading on long stolons.

images.alt: Curated variegated Spider Plant foliage with arching leaves
Spider Plant runners and delicate foliage

guide.growthHabit: Rosette of arching slender foliage producing spiderettes.
guide.soil: Standard well-draining potting soil.
guide.container: Hanging basket or elevated pedestal pot with drainage.
guide.watering: Water moderately once weekly during the growing season.
guide.routineCare: Clip and propagate spiderettes in water or potting soil.

toxicityCaution.note: Safe and non-toxic for domestic pets.

name: Rubber Tree
description: Striking sculptural specimen with thick, leathery broad leaves in rich burgundy-green tones, exuding modern botanical elegance.

images.alt: Rubber Tree plant with bold sculptural foliage
Variegated Rubber Tree plant foliage catching sunlight

guide.growthHabit: Tree form with thick upright woody stem and large oval leaves.
guide.soil: Well-draining potting mix rich in organic compost.
guide.container: Heavy ceramic or stone pot with drainage holes.
guide.watering: Water when top 3-4cm is dry to the touch.
guide.routineCare: Wipe broad leaves with a damp cloth; provide bright indirect light.

toxicityCaution.note: Milky latex sap can cause dermal or digestive irritation in pets.

name: Philodendron Birkin
description: Compact collector favourite boasting dramatic pinstripe variegation of creamy white lines across glossy dark emerald leaves.

images.alt: Philodendron Birkin glossy dark foliage with creamy pinstripes

guide.growthHabit: Self-heading compact rosette habit, does not require climbing pole.
guide.soil: Chunky aroid mix with bark, perlite, and coco coir.
guide.container: Pot with excellent drainage holes.
guide.watering: Water when top half of soil dries, roughly every 7-9 days.
guide.routineCare: Bright indirect light preserves the striking variegated striping.

toxicityCaution.note: Contains calcium oxalates; keep away from curious pets.

name: African Mask Plant
description: Dramatically sculpted arrow-shaped foliage with wavy margins and bold silvery-white venation against near-black emerald leaf surfaces.

images.alt: Alocasia Amazonica with striking white leaf veins

guide.growthHabit: Rhizomatous perennial producing arrow-shaped leaves on long petioles.
guide.soil: Airy, well-aerated chunky aroid substrate.
guide.container: Well-draining pot with permeable sidewalls.
guide.watering: Keep moist but never waterlogged; water every 5-7 days.
guide.routineCare: Prefers warm temperatures (above 18°C) and higher humidity levels.

toxicityCaution.note: Toxic to cats and dogs if ingested.

name: Jade Plant
description: Beloved succulent bonsai-like plant with thick woody stems and plump oval jade-green leaves, symbolizing good fortune and abundance.

images.alt: Minimalist desktop Jade Plant arrangement in stone bowl

guide.growthHabit: Branching succulent shrub with thick fleshy leaves.
guide.soil: Cactus and succulent potting mix with perlite or pumice.
guide.container: Heavy terracotta pot for balance and moisture evaporation.
guide.watering: Water thoroughly only when soil is completely dry.
guide.routineCare: Provide at least 4-6 hours of bright or direct sunshine daily.

toxicityCaution.note: Can cause vomiting and depression in pets if ingested.

name: Bird of Paradise
description: Regal tropical plant featuring grand banana-like paddles and exotic crane-shaped blooms in brilliant orange and azure blue.

images.alt: Exotic orange and blue Bird of Paradise flower

guide.growthHabit: Clumping erect perennial with broad paddle-shaped leaves.
guide.soil: Rich loam substrate with excellent moisture retention and drainage.
guide.container: Deep, sturdy container with multiple drainage holes.
guide.watering: Water regularly in spring/summer, allowing topsoil to dry between sessions.
guide.routineCare: Needs abundant light; tolerates several hours of direct sunshine.

toxicityCaution.note: Mildly toxic to pets; seeds are the most toxic part.

name: Boston Fern
description: Lush cascading fern with arching feathery fronds that naturally humidifies ambient air and softens interior architectural contours.

images.alt: Cascading Boston Fern fronds in architectural ceramic planter

guide.growthHabit: Clumping perennial with graceful arching pinnate fronds.
guide.soil: Rich, porous potting mix with peat moss and vermiculite.
guide.container: Hanging basket or elevated pedestal pot with drainage.
guide.watering: Maintain consistent moisture; never let root ball dry out completely.
guide.routineCare: Provide bright filtered light and generous ambient humidity.

toxicityCaution.note: Non-toxic and completely pet-safe.

name: String of Pearls
description: Whimsical trailing succulent with slender thread-like stems draped in spherical pea-like green bead foliage.

images.alt: Trailing String of Pearls succulent beads cascading gently

guide.growthHabit: Pendant trailing succulent stems cascading up to 1 meter.
guide.soil: Fast-draining gritty succulent mix.
guide.container: Shallow hanging planter with bottom drainage.
guide.watering: Water when pearl spheres soften slightly; roughly every 10-14 days.
guide.routineCare: Ensure top of pot receives bright light; avoid overwatering.

toxicityCaution.note: Toxic to pets; can cause lethargy and digestive distress.

name: English Ivy
description: Vigorous evergreen trailing climber with classic lobed leaves, ideal for hanging baskets or climbing decorative trellises.

images.alt: Lush green English Ivy climbing with distinctive lobed leaves

guide.growthHabit: Vigorous climbing and trailing woody evergreen vine.
guide.soil: Standard moist, fertile, well-drained potting compost.
guide.container: Hanging planter or pot with trellis framework.
guide.watering: Water when top 2cm feels dry; avoid standing in water.
guide.routineCare: Thrives in cooler room temperatures and medium to bright light.

toxicityCaution.note: Foliage contains triterpenoid saponins.

name: Cast-Iron Plant
description: Renowned for its indestructible stamina, with broad dark green lance-shaped leaves thriving in low-light, low-humidity spaces.

images.alt: Resilient Cast-Iron Plant broad dark green foliage

guide.growthHabit: Clumping upright foliage growing directly from underground rhizomes.
guide.soil: Standard well-draining indoor potting mix.
guide.container: Heavy ceramic or plastic pot with good drainage.
guide.watering: Water moderately when top 5cm of soil is dry.
guide.routineCare: Wipe dust from broad leaves; tolerates wide temperature swings.

toxicityCaution.note: Non-toxic and safe for all household pets.

name: Flamingo Flower
description: Dazzling tropical beauty featuring glossy heart-shaped foliage crowned with long-lasting waxy scarlet spathes and yellow spadices.

images.alt: Vibrant scarlet Anthurium bloom with yellow spadix

guide.growthHabit: Epiphytic clumping perennial with heart-shaped leaves and showy spathes.
guide.soil: Coarse, well-aerated orchid and aroid potting mix.
guide.container: Pot with drainage; ensure roots have adequate airflow.
guide.watering: Water when top 3cm of soil dries; do not leave water in the saucer.
guide.routineCare: Bright indirect light encourages continuous flower spathe blooms.

toxicityCaution.note: Contains calcium oxalate crystals; toxic to pets.

name: Aloe Vera
description: Timeless succulent revered for its soothing gel-filled lanceolate leaves adorned with soft serrated edges. Thrives in sunlit corners.

images.alt: Fresh Aloe Vera succulent with thick fleshy gel leaves

guide.growthHabit: Stemless rosette of thick fleshy erect leaves.
guide.soil: Porous cactus or succulent soil with sand and perlite.
guide.container: Wide, shallow unglazed terracotta pot with drainage.
guide.watering: Soak thoroughly and allow soil to dry out completely before next watering.
guide.routineCare: Place in direct or bright sunlight for optimal vigor.

toxicityCaution.note: Gel is soothing for humans, but rind contains aloin which is toxic to pets.
